# Career Settings — Production-Grade UI Polish

## Context
The Career Settings page was restructured into 5 tabs. The logic works. The UI needs production-grade polish to match the dashboard quality. This is a UI-only pass — no logic changes.

## File: `src/pages/CareerSettings.tsx`

### Tab bar
- Add icons to each tab trigger (Palette for Branding, FileText for Content, Share2 for Social & SEO, Briefcase for Jobs, Code2 for Advanced)
- Tab triggers: `font-medium` text, smoother `data-[state=active]` transition

### Branding tab
- Split into two side-by-side cards on desktop: "Identity" (left: company name, slug, tagline) + "Appearance" (right: logo, brand color, cover image, font)
- Use `grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4` for the two-column layout
- Logo URL: add inline preview (small avatar-size circle if URL is set)
- Brand color: larger swatch preview (h-12 w-12 rounded-xl)
- Cover image: taller preview (h-40) with overlay gradient
- Font selector: show font preview text below selector in the selected font
- Publish toggle: move to a standalone accent card with green/muted styling based on state

### Content tab  
- About: add a subtle character counter at bottom-right
- Benefits: redesign benefit cards with a grid layout (2 columns), nicer card with rounded-xl, subtle background, icon displayed as colored circle
- Empty state for benefits: add an illustration-style icon instead of just text

### Social & SEO tab
- Social links: use icon-only labels on the left (remove text label on right), add placeholder text inside input
- SEO card: add a Google search preview showing how the meta title/description will look

### Jobs tab
- Subscriber card: add a mini trend indicator or "new this week" badge
- Jobs table: add row hover highlighting matching dashboard table style

### Advanced tab
- CSS editor: add syntax-highlighting-style dark bg for the textarea (`bg-zinc-950 text-emerald-400 font-mono` in dark mode)
- Custom domain card: more visual — add a lock icon, make the checklist items have colored check icons

## Verification
- `npm run build` — no errors
- Visual check: all tabs look polished, consistent with dashboard cards

# Dashboard Layout Structure Analysis

## Sidebar
- **Width**: `calc(var(--spacing) * 64)` (16rem/256px default)
- **Background**: Inset variant with muted tone
- **Text Styles**: Navigation items use standard text sizing; section labels appear as category headers
- **Active/Inactive States**: Hover effects with `hover:bg-accent` and `hover:text-accent-foreground`
- **Border**: Inset border styling (no visible shadow on sidebar itself)

## Content Area
- **Background**: `bg-muted/40` with light gray tone
- **Border-Radius**: Top-left appears rounded through container styling
- **Padding**: `p-(--content-padding)` with `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)` spacing
- **Responsive**: Centered layout on XL screens via `@container/main`

## Header/Top Bar
- **Height**: `--header-height: calc(var(--spacing) * 14)` (56px)
- **Background**: Integrated with content area
- **Items**: Title ("Sales Dashboard"), date range, download button
- **Border**: None visible; seamless integration with content

## Overall Layout Separation
- **Gap**: `--content-margin: calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5)` creates subtle spacing
- **Visual Distinction**: Sidebar uses darker/neutral tone; content uses `bg-muted/40` (lighter)
- **Rounded Corners**: Applied to content container, not sidebar
- **Relationship**: Sidebar is fixed left; content flexes and fills remaining space

## Key Tailwind Classes
`grid`, `flex-col`, `rounded-xl`, `border`, `bg-card`, `bg-background`, `space-y-4`, `md:grid-cols-2`, `xl:grid-cols-8`

## Color Scheme
Sidebar: neutral/muted tones | Content: lighter secondary background with card elements using `bg-card` for contrast

Need to match that exact pattern: sidebar with distinct muted tone, content area with rounded corners + subtle margin/gap, header inside content area. ## Key Differences (current vs target) | Element | Current | Target (shadcnuikit) | |---------|---------|---------------------| | Sidebar bg | `220 14% 96%` (almost white) | Noticeably muted/cooler tone | | Content wrapper | `rounded-tl-2xl` only | `rounded-xl` all corners with margin gap | | Content bg | `bg-background` | `bg-muted/40` behind cards, cards are `bg-card` | | Gap | No gap between sidebar and content | Small margin gap (`6px`) around content | | Header | `border-b` heavy | Seamless, inside rounded container | | Sidebar border | `border-r-0` | No border, tone difference is enough | ## Changes ### 1. `src/index.css` — Sidebar colors (light mode only, don't touch dark) ``` --rk-sidebar-background: 220 16% 93%; /* was 96%, more contrast now */ --rk-sidebar-accent: 220 14% 97%; /* was 0 0% 100% */ --rk-sidebar-border: 220 13% 88%; /* was 91%, slightly more visible */ ``` ### 2. `src/components/SidebarLayout.tsx` — Content wrapper ```tsx
...
``` - `p-1.5 pl-0` creates gap on top/right/bottom but flush with sidebar on left - `rounded-xl` instead of just `rounded-tl-2xl` — all corners rounded - Remove `border-l border-t border-border/40` — shadow handles it ### 3. `src/pages/Index.tsx` — Same content wrapper pattern ### 4. `src/components/AppHeader.tsx` — Remove border-b, make seamless Change `border-b border-border bg-card` → `bg-transparent` (header blends into content) ## Files - `src/index.css` (light sidebar vars) - `src/components/SidebarLayout.tsx` - `src/pages/Index.tsx` - `src/components/AppHeader.tsx` ## Verification - `npm run build` - Visual: sidebar visibly different tone, content area floats with rounded corners + gap

# Agency Hub — Full Build Plan

## Context
Agency Hub is currently a "Coming Soon" placeholder with zero functionality. Need to build the complete agency workflow: Client Management, Mandates, Communication, Placements, Invoicing, Commission. No DB tables, hooks, or components exist.

## Architecture

### DB Tables Needed (via Supabase migrations)
1. `agency_clients` — id, team_id, company_name, industry, website, logo_url, sla_days, status (active/inactive/churned), notes, created_at
2. `agency_contacts` — id, client_id, name, email, phone, role, is_primary, created_at
3. `agency_mandates` — id, client_id, team_id, job_title, description, priority (high/medium/low), status (open/in_progress/filled/cancelled), fee_type (percentage/flat/retainer), fee_amount, deadline, created_at
4. `agency_communications` — id, client_id, mandate_id (nullable), user_id, type (email/call/note/meeting), subject, body, created_at
5. `agency_placements` — id, mandate_id, client_id, candidate_name, candidate_email, status (offered/accepted/started/guarantee/completed/fallen_off), start_date, salary, fee_amount, guarantee_days, guarantee_expires_at, created_at
6. `agency_invoices` — id, placement_id, client_id, team_id, invoice_number, amount, currency, status (draft/sent/paid/overdue), due_date, paid_at, created_at
7. `agency_commissions` — id, placement_id, user_id, amount, percentage, status (pending/approved/paid), period, created_at

### Tab Implementation Plan

**Tab 1: Client Management** — CRUD for clients + contacts
- Client list table with search, status filter
- Add Client dialog (company_name, industry, website, SLA)
- Client detail sheet: contacts, active mandates count, total placements, communication log
- Add/edit contacts per client

**Tab 2: Mandates** (renamed from CV Reformatter — more useful)
- Mandate list linked to clients
- Create mandate dialog: select client, job_title, priority, fee_type, fee_amount, deadline
- Mandate status pipeline: Open → In Progress → Filled/Cancelled
- Link to existing jobs in Rankora for candidate matching

**Tab 3: Placements**
- Placement list with status badges
- Create placement from mandate: candidate details, salary, fee, guarantee period
- Status flow: Offered → Accepted → Started → Guarantee → Completed
- Guarantee expiry tracking with visual countdown

**Tab 4: Invoicing**
- Auto-generate invoice from placement
- Invoice list with status (Draft/Sent/Paid/Overdue)
- Mark as paid, send reminder
- Export to CSV

**Tab 5: Commission**
- Commission per placement per user
- Summary view: total earned, pending, paid
- Period filter (monthly)
- Export for payroll

### Files to Create
- `src/hooks/useAgencyClients.ts` — CRUD hook for clients + contacts
- `src/hooks/useAgencyMandates.ts` — CRUD for mandates
- `src/hooks/useAgencyPlacements.ts` — CRUD for placements
- `src/hooks/useAgencyInvoices.ts` — CRUD for invoices
- `src/hooks/useAgencyCommissions.ts` — read/calculate commissions
- `src/pages/AgencyHub.tsx` — full rewrite with real tabs

### Files to Modify
- `src/pages/AgencyHub.tsx` — replace placeholder with real functionality

### Approach
Since we don't have DB migration access from Claude Code, build the UI with Supabase queries using `(supabase as any)` pattern (same as other features). Tables will need to be created via Lovable or Supabase dashboard. Build the complete UI now — it will work as soon as tables exist.

## Build Order
1. Hooks (all 5 — data layer)
2. AgencyHub.tsx rewrite (5 functional tabs)
3. Build + push

## Verification
- `npm run build` — no errors
- All tabs render without crash
- Forms, tables, dialogs functional (will show empty until DB tables created)

**Which tables get `updated_at` triggers.** Only tables that have an `updated_at` column need one: `agency_clients`, `agency_mandates`, `agency_placements`. Here is the complete plan before I execute:

---

## Plan

### File 1: `src/hooks/useAgencyCommunications.ts` (new)

Follows the exact same pattern as `useAgencyContacts` in `useAgencyClients.ts`. **New imports:** `BarChart3`, `MessageSquare`, `Phone`, `Mail`, `Calendar`, `Lock`, `Star`, `useAgencyContacts`, `useAgencyCommunications`

**New helper — `clientAvatarColor(name)`:** Hashes company name to one of 8 distinct Tailwind bg/text color pairs so avatars are colored, not just gray.

**New component — `ClientDetailPanel`:** Shown below the clients table when a row is clicked. Uses `useAgencyContacts` and `useAgencyCommunications`. Shows contacts list + communications log table with Type badge (color coded by type), Subject, Body preview, Date. "Add Note" / "Log Call" / "Log Email" / "Log Meeting" buttons open a small dialog that pre-selects the type.

**ClientsTab changes:**
- `selectedClientId` state (string | null) — clicking a row toggles it
- Avatar circle uses `clientAvatarColor()` instead of plain muted box
- "Since {date}" subtitle under company name
- Active mandate count + placements count columns already existed — now using the colored avatar
- `<ClientDetailPanel>` renders after the table Card conditionally

**MandatesTab changes:**
- Add deadline countdown: compute days left, show "X days left" in red if overdue, amber if ≤7 days, replacing the plain date display
- Priority badges are already color-coded via `StatusBadge`

**PlacementsTab changes:**
- `fallen_off` status rows get a subtle red left border via `cn()` on `TableRow`
- Guarantee column: replace `GuarantyBadge` with `GuaranteeProgress` — shows progress bar (days remaining / total guarantee_days) + label

**InvoicingTab changes:**
- Overdue rows highlighted with amber row background via `cn()` on `TableRow`
- Invoice number already auto-generated

**CommissionTab changes:**
- Approved commissions get a subtle green left border accent; pending get amber

**New `AnalyticsTab`:** Computes from existing `useAgencyPlacements` + `useAgencyInvoices` + `useAgencyClients` data. Shows 4 summary cards (Total Revenue, Revenue This Month, Avg Fee Per Placement, Conversion Rate), Revenue by Client horizontal bar list, Placements per Month table (last 6 months), Top Clients by Placements list.

**New `ClientPortalTab`:** Static teaser card. Feature list with check icons. "Request Early Access" button fires `toast.success`. "Coming Soon" badge.

**Empty states:** Each tab gets a full centered empty state with large muted icon + "No X yet" heading + subtitle + CTA button, shown when the data is empty and not loading, replacing the `EmptyRow` inside the table.

**Tab order:** clients, mandates, placements, invoicing, commission, analytics, client-portal — matches the spec exactly.

**Build verification:** `npm run build` run after all changes, errors fixed.

---

### Blocking Issues (fix before deploy)
- **Issue 1** (CRITICAL): `useAgencyCommissions` has zero team scoping -- potential cross-tenant data leak
- **Issue 2** (CRITICAL): `useAgencyPlacements` fallback query fetches all placements globally

### Should Fix (non-blocking but important)
- **Issue 3**: `handleDeleteJobs` missing error handling
- **Issue 4**: Regenerate Supabase types (149 `as any` casts)
- **Issue 5**: Silent error swallowing in all agency hooks
- **Issue 7**: Reports page sequential queries + O(n*m) client computation
- **Issue 8**: Verify avatar storage bucket RLS

- Issues 11-16: Dead props, a11y labels, type cleanup, file splitting

1. Fix issues 1 and 2 (agency data isolation)
2. Fix issue 3 (delete error handling)
3. Regenerate types (issue 4)
4. Submit changed files for re-review (Mode D)

**DEPLOY BLOCKED** -- Fix the 2 CRITICAL data isolation issues in `useAgencyCommissions.ts` and `useAgencyPlacements.ts` before shipping to production. Once those are fixed and RLS policies are verified on all agency tables, re-submit for Mode D review.</result>

<result>Here is a complete audit report. I am in plan mode so I cannot make edits yet, but here is every real bug found with exact file locations, root causes, and fixes ready to apply.

---

## Audit Results — Rankora UI/UX Bugs

### BUG 1 — P2: Bare `<Card>` missing border/shadow — Index.tsx line 359

**Root cause:** The "Getting Started" card on the dashboard has no `className`, while every other card in the same file uses `border border-border/60 shadow-sm`.

**File:** `src/pages/Index.tsx` line 359

Old:
```tsx
<Card>
```
New:
```tsx
<Card className="border border-border/60 shadow-sm">
```

---

### BUG 2 — P2: Bare `<Card>` + missing shadow — RequestFeature.tsx lines 314 and 323

**Root cause:** Two cards have inconsistent styling. The empty state card (line 314) has no classes at all. The feature request item card (line 323) has `border` but no `shadow-sm`.

**File:** `src/pages/RequestFeature.tsx`

Line 314 old:
```tsx
<Card>
```
Line 314 new:
```tsx
<Card className="border border-border/60 shadow-sm">
```

Line 323 old:
```tsx
<Card key={r.id} className="border hover:border-border/80 transition-colors">
```
Line 323 new:
```tsx
<Card key={r.id} className="border border-border/60 shadow-sm hover:border-border/80 hover:shadow-md transition-all">
```

---

### BUG 3 — P2: Inconsistent padding — RequestFeature.tsx and BookDemo.tsx

**Root cause:** Both pages use `mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10` which constrains width and uses smaller padding. All other authenticated pages use `w-full px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-8` (full width, wider padding).

**File:** `src/pages/RequestFeature.tsx` line 194

Old: `<main className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10 space-y-8">`
New: `<main className="w-full px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-8 space-y-8">`

**File:** `src/pages/BookDemo.tsx` line 70

Old: `<main className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10 space-y-8">`
New: `<main className="w-full px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-8 space-y-8">`

---

### BUG 4 — P2: Admin page uses flat `p-6` padding instead of responsive standard

**Root cause:** Admin.tsx uses a custom layout (not SidebarLayout) and its main content area uses `p-6` — no responsive variants, smaller padding, inconsistent with all other pages.

**File:** `src/pages/Admin.tsx` line 42

Old: `<main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6">`
New: `<main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-8">`

---

### BUG 5 — P2: SidebarLayout mobile trigger missing "Menu" label

**Root cause:** Index.tsx has a mobile trigger bar with both `<SidebarTrigger />` and a "Menu" label. SidebarLayout (used by all other pages) only has `<SidebarTrigger />` with no label — the bar looks visually empty next to the icon.

**File:** `src/components/SidebarLayout.tsx` line 31

Old:
```tsx
<div className="flex items-center h-10 px-4 md:hidden">
  <SidebarTrigger />
</div>
```
New:
```tsx
<div className="flex items-center h-10 px-4 md:hidden">
  <SidebarTrigger />
  <span className="ml-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Menu</span>
</div>
```

---

### BUG 6 — P2: Dark mode sidebar active item contrast too low

**Root cause:** In dark mode, `--rk-sidebar-accent` is `220 14% 10%` (used for active nav item background) while `--rk-sidebar-background` is `220 14% 5%`. Only 5 lightness points apart — active nav items are barely distinguishable from the sidebar background.

**File:** `src/index.css` line 104

Old: `--rk-sidebar-accent: 220 14% 10%;`
New: `--rk-sidebar-accent: 220 14% 14%;`

This brings the active item contrast from ~1.1:1 to a more visible ~1.25:1 against the sidebar.

---

### BUG 7 — P1: `hasSidebar` context check uses strict null, misses undefined

**Root cause:** `useContext(SidebarContext) !== null` — if `SidebarContext` defaults to `undefined` (no value provided), the strict `!== null` check returns `true` even on pages without a SidebarProvider. This would cause the sidebar trigger to render when it shouldn't.

**File:** `src/components/AppHeader.tsx` line 93

Old: `const hasSidebar = useContext(SidebarContext) !== null;`
New: `const hasSidebar = useContext(SidebarContext) != null;`

(Loose inequality `!= null` catches both `null` and `undefined`.)

---

## What Was NOT Broken

- **All authenticated pages use SidebarLayout** — Settings, Billing, Team, Tasks, Reports, TalentPool, AgencyHub, CareerSettings, Integrations, Profile, RequestFeature, BookDemo, Changelog all import and use `SidebarLayout`. No missing sidebar wrappers.
- **Sidebar collapsed icon mode** — `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden` is correctly applied to all label spans. `SidebarMenuButton` has `tooltip={label}` on all nav items. Collapsed mode is correct.
- **Header breadcrumb** — `ROUTE_LABELS` covers all routes in the app. The `isSubPage` logic and `BreadcrumbPage`/`BreadcrumbLink` switching is correct.
- **Content wrapper consistency** — Both `SidebarLayout` and `Index.tsx` use identical `rounded-xl border bg-background` wrapper with sticky header and scrolling content.
- **Loading states** — All data-fetching pages (Team, Reports, TalentPool, Profile, Changelog, RequestFeature) have `Skeleton` or `Loader2` loading states.
- **No `max-w-5xl`/`max-w-6xl` in app pages** — Only found in `LandingPage.tsx` (public marketing, where centering is correct), `CareerJobDetail.tsx` (public job page, correct), `JDGeneratorDialog`/`JDRewriteDialog` (dialogs, correct), and the two pages fixed in Bug 3.

---

## Summary

| # | Severity | File | Issue |
|---|----------|------|-------|
| 1 | P2 | Index.tsx:359 | Bare `<Card>` no border/shadow |
| 2 | P2 | RequestFeature.tsx:314,323 | Bare card + missing shadow-sm |

| 6 | P2 | index.css:104 | Dark sidebar accent too low contrast |
| 7 | P1 | AppHeader.tsx:93 | Strict null check misses undefined |

7 bugs total. No P0 issues. All fixable with targeted edits. Ready to apply — confirm to proceed and I will fix all 7 and run `npm run build`.</result>

# Agency Hub — Full Build Plan

## Context
Agency Hub is currently a "Coming Soon" placeholder with zero functionality. Need to build the complete agency workflow: Client Management, Mandates, Communication, Placements, Invoicing, Commission. No DB tables, hooks, or components exist.

## Architecture

### DB Tables Needed (via Supabase migrations)
1. `agency_clients` — id, team_id, company_name, industry, website, logo_url, sla_days, status (active/inactive/churned), notes, created_at
2. `agency_contacts` — id, client_id, name, email, phone, role, is_primary, created_at
3. `agency_mandates` — id, client_id, team_id, job_title, description, priority (high/medium/low), status (open/in_progress/filled/cancelled), fee_type (percentage/flat/retainer), fee_amount, deadline, created_at
4. `agency_communications` — id, client_id, mandate_id (nullable), user_id, type (email/call/note/meeting), subject, body, created_at
5. `agency_placements` — id, mandate_id, client_id, candidate_name, candidate_email, status (offered/accepted/started/guarantee/completed/fallen_off), start_date, salary, fee_amount, guarantee_days, guarantee_expires_at, created_at
6. `agency_invoices` — id, placement_id, client_id, team_id, invoice_number, amount, currency, status (draft/sent/paid/overdue), due_date, paid_at, created_at
7. `agency_commissions` — id, placement_id, user_id, amount, percentage, status (pending/approved/paid), period, created_at

### Tab Implementation Plan

**Tab 1: Client Management** — CRUD for clients + contacts
- Client list table with search, status filter
- Add Client dialog (company_name, industry, website, SLA)
- Client detail sheet: contacts, active mandates count, total placements, communication log
- Add/edit contacts per client

**Tab 2: Mandates** (renamed from CV Reformatter — more useful)
- Mandate list linked to clients
- Create mandate dialog: select client, job_title, priority, fee_type, fee_amount, deadline
- Mandate status pipeline: Open → In Progress → Filled/Cancelled
- Link to existing jobs in Rankora for candidate matching

**Tab 3: Placements**
- Placement list with status badges
- Create placement from mandate: candidate details, salary, fee, guarantee period
- Status flow: Offered → Accepted → Started → Guarantee → Completed
- Guarantee expiry tracking with visual countdown

**Tab 4: Invoicing**
- Auto-generate invoice from placement
- Invoice list with status (Draft/Sent/Paid/Overdue)
- Mark as paid, send reminder
- Export to CSV

**Tab 5: Commission**
- Commission per placement per user
- Summary view: total earned, pending, paid
- Period filter (monthly)
- Export for payroll

### Files to Create
- `src/hooks/useAgencyClients.ts` — CRUD hook for clients + contacts
- `src/hooks/useAgencyMandates.ts` — CRUD for mandates
- `src/hooks/useAgencyPlacements.ts` — CRUD for placements
- `src/hooks/useAgencyInvoices.ts` — CRUD for invoices
- `src/hooks/useAgencyCommissions.ts` — read/calculate commissions
- `src/pages/AgencyHub.tsx` — full rewrite with real tabs

### Files to Modify
- `src/pages/AgencyHub.tsx` — replace placeholder with real functionality

### Approach
Since we don't have DB migration access from Claude Code, build the UI with Supabase queries using `(supabase as any)` pattern (same as other features). Tables will need to be created via Lovable or Supabase dashboard. Build the complete UI now — it will work as soon as tables exist.

## Build Order
1. Hooks (all 5 — data layer)
2. AgencyHub.tsx rewrite (5 functional tabs)
3. Build + push

## Verification
- `npm run build` — no errors
- All tabs render without crash
- Forms, tables, dialogs functional (will show empty until DB tables created)

<result>Here is a complete audit report. I am in plan mode so I cannot make edits yet, but here is every real bug found with exact file locations, root causes, and fixes ready to apply.

---

## Audit Results — Rankora UI/UX Bugs

### BUG 1 — P2: Bare `<Card>` missing border/shadow — Index.tsx line 359

**Root cause:** The "Getting Started" card on the dashboard has no `className`, while every other card in the same file uses `border border-border/60 shadow-sm`.

**File:** `src/pages/Index.tsx` line 359

Old:
```tsx
<Card>
```
New:
```tsx
<Card className="border border-border/60 shadow-sm">
```

---

### BUG 2 — P2: Bare `<Card>` + missing shadow — RequestFeature.tsx lines 314 and 323

**Root cause:** Two cards have inconsistent styling. The empty state card (line 314) has no classes at all. The feature request item card (line 323) has `border` but no `shadow-sm`.

**File:** `src/pages/RequestFeature.tsx`

Line 314 old:
```tsx
<Card>
```
Line 314 new:
```tsx
<Card className="border border-border/60 shadow-sm">
```

Line 323 old:
```tsx
<Card key={r.id} className="border hover:border-border/80 transition-colors">
```
Line 323 new:
```tsx
<Card key={r.id} className="border border-border/60 shadow-sm hover:border-border/80 hover:shadow-md transition-all">
```

---

### BUG 3 — P2: Inconsistent padding — RequestFeature.tsx and BookDemo.tsx

**Root cause:** Both pages use `mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10` which constrains width and uses smaller padding. All other authenticated pages use `w-full px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-8` (full width, wider padding).

**File:** `src/pages/RequestFeature.tsx` line 194

Old: `<main className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10 space-y-8">`
New: `<main className="w-full px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-8 space-y-8">`

**File:** `src/pages/BookDemo.tsx` line 70

Old: `<main className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10 space-y-8">`
New: `<main className="w-full px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-8 space-y-8">`

---

### BUG 4 — P2: Admin page uses flat `p-6` padding instead of responsive standard

**Root cause:** Admin.tsx uses a custom layout (not SidebarLayout) and its main content area uses `p-6` — no responsive variants, smaller padding, inconsistent with all other pages.

**File:** `src/pages/Admin.tsx` line 42

Old: `<main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6">`
New: `<main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-8">`

---

### BUG 5 — P2: SidebarLayout mobile trigger missing "Menu" label

**Root cause:** Index.tsx has a mobile trigger bar with both `<SidebarTrigger />` and a "Menu" label. SidebarLayout (used by all other pages) only has `<SidebarTrigger />` with no label — the bar looks visually empty next to the icon.

**File:** `src/components/SidebarLayout.tsx` line 31

Old:
```tsx
<div className="flex items-center h-10 px-4 md:hidden">
  <SidebarTrigger />
</div>
```
New:
```tsx
<div className="flex items-center h-10 px-4 md:hidden">
  <SidebarTrigger />
  <span className="ml-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Menu</span>
</div>
```

---

### BUG 6 — P2: Dark mode sidebar active item contrast too low

**Root cause:** In dark mode, `--rk-sidebar-accent` is `220 14% 10%` (used for active nav item background) while `--rk-sidebar-background` is `220 14% 5%`. Only 5 lightness points apart — active nav items are barely distinguishable from the sidebar background.

**File:** `src/index.css` line 104

Old: `--rk-sidebar-accent: 220 14% 10%;`
New: `--rk-sidebar-accent: 220 14% 14%;`

This brings the active item contrast from ~1.1:1 to a more visible ~1.25:1 against the sidebar.

---

### BUG 7 — P1: `hasSidebar` context check uses strict null, misses undefined

**Root cause:** `useContext(SidebarContext) !== null` — if `SidebarContext` defaults to `undefined` (no value provided), the strict `!== null` check returns `true` even on pages without a SidebarProvider. This would cause the sidebar trigger to render when it shouldn't.

**File:** `src/components/AppHeader.tsx` line 93

Old: `const hasSidebar = useContext(SidebarContext) !== null;`
New: `const hasSidebar = useContext(SidebarContext) != null;`

(Loose inequality `!= null` catches both `null` and `undefined`.)

---

## What Was NOT Broken

- **All authenticated pages use SidebarLayout** — Settings, Billing, Team, Tasks, Reports, TalentPool, AgencyHub, CareerSettings, Integrations, Profile, RequestFeature, BookDemo, Changelog all import and use `SidebarLayout`. No missing sidebar wrappers.
- **Sidebar collapsed icon mode** — `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden` is correctly applied to all label spans. `SidebarMenuButton` has `tooltip={label}` on all nav items. Collapsed mode is correct.
- **Header breadcrumb** — `ROUTE_LABELS` covers all routes in the app. The `isSubPage` logic and `BreadcrumbPage`/`BreadcrumbLink` switching is correct.
- **Content wrapper consistency** — Both `SidebarLayout` and `Index.tsx` use identical `rounded-xl border bg-background` wrapper with sticky header and scrolling content.
- **Loading states** — All data-fetching pages (Team, Reports, TalentPool, Profile, Changelog, RequestFeature) have `Skeleton` or `Loader2` loading states.
- **No `max-w-5xl`/`max-w-6xl` in app pages** — Only found in `LandingPage.tsx` (public marketing, where centering is correct), `CareerJobDetail.tsx` (public job page, correct), `JDGeneratorDialog`/`JDRewriteDialog` (dialogs, correct), and the two pages fixed in Bug 3.

| 6 | P2 | index.css:104 | Dark sidebar accent too low contrast |
| 7 | P1 | AppHeader.tsx:93 | Strict null check misses undefined |

7 bugs total. No P0 issues. All fixable with targeted edits. Ready to apply — confirm to proceed and I will fix all 7 and run `npm run build`.</result>
